EL-01 · Electronics

PCB and electronic design

Circuit design, PCB development, embedded systems and customised electronics engineering.

Discuss your project

Hardware decisions made early are expensive to change later. KT INDIA takes electronic products from circuit design through PCB development, embedded firmware and prototype.

The team has published a technical white paper on scalable embedded systems using ARM-based platforms, covering platform selection, firmware architecture and safety qualification.

A good fit when

  • You need a custom board rather than an off-the-shelf module.
  • You have a prototype that needs to become a product.
  • Your product needs hardware and software designed together.

What this covers

  • Circuit design
  • PCB development
  • Embedded systems
  • Protocols and standards
  • Prototypes
  • Customised electronic products

Process

How the work runs

  1. 01

    Discover / Research

    Define the real problem, the users and the constraints before choosing a technology.

  2. 02

    Engineer / Build

    Design and build across software, electronics and AI, using whichever combination fits.

  3. 03

    Validate / Evidence

    Test against the requirement with data, not assumptions. Evidence before assumption.

  4. 04

    Deliver / Impact

    Ship a working system, document it and support it as it is used.
